'''Zsall Dubrotin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] who was a member of the powerful [[Bomminde family]], daughter of [[Zom Dubrotin]]. She was a secret [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel]] ally during the [[Rebellion era]].<ref name="University" />

During the [[New Jedi Order era]], Zsall, at that time family elder, was ruler of the Bomminde family. After the invasion of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|Yuuzhan Vong]] in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], the Bomminde became the ruling family of the invasion survivors. The family provided intelligence to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in exchange for food and medical supplies. She ruled from a base in [[Tejrivozs]], with [[Brin Bimdin]] acting as one of her most trusted agents.  Additionally, she was a leader of the Advosec resistance against the Yuuzhan Vong invasion.<ref name="University" />
